events.title: Morning Hike at Mount Spokane
events.thought: The morning at Mount Spokane was unremarkable in the best possible way — cool air, good trail, no evacuation orders.
events.photoCaption: Morning hike at Mount Spokane State Park near Bald Knob Campground before departure.

events.title: Old Trails Fire: Smoke Over Spokane
events.thought: Those plumes were not scenic — they were inside the city, and the phones confirmed it before I had time to form a second opinion.
events.photoCaption: Massive smoke columns from the Old Trails Fire rising from inside the city of Spokane, WA — orange-brown sky with the sun barely visible as multiple plumes tower over suburban rooftops and a treeline along the road.
photoNote: Working the backroads into Spokane, I spotted smoke plumes that appeared to originate from inside the city itself.
The phones issued Level 3 evacuation orders shortly after. I interpreted this as a signal to revise the plan.

events.title: Level 3 Evacuation: Old Trails Fire, Spokane
events.thought: The evacuation zone was expanding quickly and Riverside State Park was in the path — the decision to leave was not a difficult one.
events.photoCaption: iPhone lock screen showing critical emergency alerts for the Old Trails Fire in Spokane, WA — Level 3 Evacuations expanding for a large region, with a traffic alert restricting access to evacuation routes. Gaia GPS shows the vehicle nearly stopped at 45.93 miles into the day.

events.title: Liberty Lake County Park: Plan B Executed
events.thought: Plan A was Riverside State Park. The Old Trails Fire had other ideas.
events.photoCaption: Waldo fully deployed at Liberty Lake County Park — habitat module pop-top raised, awning extended, camp stove set out in a pine-shaded gravel campsite.
photoNote: Report. Day 39 — Mount Spokane State Park to Liberty Lake County Park.
Plan A was Riverside State Park. A wildfire in Spokane triggered Level 3 evacuations across the city, including Riverside State Park.
Plan B was Liberty Lake County Park. Plan B was adequate.
